name: run_deseq2_r
description: Run DESeq2 differential expression analysis using R's original DESeq2 package (not pydeseq2). Generates volcano plot, MA plot, and full results CSV. Requires R + DESeq2 installed.

parameters.counts_path: string — path to count matrix CSV (genes as rows, samples as columns, integer values)
parameters.metadata_path: string — path to sample metadata CSV (samples as rows, condition as column)
parameters.reference_level: string — reference condition e.g. 'control' or 'young' (default NULL = alphabetical first)

returns: dict with stdout summary, output_files (volcano_plot.png, ma_plot.png, deseq2_results.csv)
